title.purpose: Section row titles (Movies/Series); no eyebrow above it.

body.purpose: Synopsis text in hero and detail overlay.

label.purpose: Card titles, tab labels, buttons, hints, metadata.

shadows.name: glow
shadows.purpose: Poster/card hover-or-focus lift. Never present at rest.

shadows.name: modal-shadow
shadows.purpose: Seats glass modals and the toast above the canvas.

shadows.name: detail-poster-shadow
shadows.purpose: Static exception: detail-view poster thumbnail over the backdrop image needs constant separation.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for lift, modal, and toast transitions.

motion.name: hero-drift
motion.purpose: Ambient compositor-only drift on hero/detail backdrop art; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: card-in
motion.value: 0.4s ease-out backwards, opacity 0->1 + translateY(10px)->0, staggered by 40ms * index

components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.description: Play / primary modal action; solid white pill, black text.
components.css: .ds-pill-btn-primary { background: #ffffff; color: #000000; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 11px 26px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-pill-btn-primary:hover { background: #e5e5e7; } .ds-pill-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-pill-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Pill Button
components.description: More Info / back / ghost action over dark or glass surfaces.
components.css: .ds-pill-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); color: #f5f5f7; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 11px 26px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-pill-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.28); } .ds-pill-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-pill-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab Pill Group
components.description: Centered Movies/Series segmented control in the glass topbar.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px; width: fit-content; } .ds-tab { background: none; border: none; color: #98989d; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 7px 20px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-tab-active { color: #000; background: #fff; } .ds-tab:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Poster Card
components.description: Grid poster tile: flat at rest, scale+lift+glow only on hover/focus.
components.css: .ds-card { cursor: pointer; border-radius: 14px; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-visible { transform: scale(1.08) translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08), 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 0 24px rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-card:active { transform: scale(1.02) translateY(-2px); } .ds-poster { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 2/3; object-fit: cover; background: #1c1c1e; border-radius: 14px; display: block; } .ds-card-meta { padding: 8px 2px 0; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; color: #f5f5f7; } .ds-card-sub { font-size: 12px; color: #98989d; }

components.name: Glass Topbar
components.description: Sticky frosted-glass utility bar: brand left, tabs centered, icon actions right.
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 14px 32px; position: sticky; top: 0; background: rgba(20,20,22,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-brand { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.2px; color: #f5f5f7; }

components.name: Glass Modal
components.description: Settings/Fix-match modal box: frosted glass, 18px radius, scale-in on open.
components.css: .ds-modal-box { background: rgba(28,28,30,0.78); backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(160%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06), 0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); padding: 26px; border-radius: 18px; width: min(420px, 90vw); color: #f5f5f7; } .ds-modal-box h2 { margin-top: 0; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-modal-box label { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: #98989d; margin: 14px 0 4px; } .ds-modal-box input { width: 100%; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); color: #f5f5f7; font-size: 13px; } .ds-modal-box input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #fff; }

components.name: Glass Toast
components.description: Non-blocking bottom-center notification replacing alert(); same glass-pill grammar as topbar/modals.
components.css: .ds-toast { background: rgba(28,28,30,0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #f5f5f7; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08), 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); text-align: center; }

narrative.northStar: The Apple TV App, Rendered on the Web
narrative.overview: My Library refuses the generic dark-mode Netflix-clone template. It is a direct translation of tvOS's own grammar into HTML/CSS/JS: a slim glass utility bar, focus-lift poster shelves that stay static-shadow-free at rest, and full-bleed detail takeovers with a bottom-left title lockup instead of a centered banner card. Nothing in the system is decorative for its own sake; every glass surface, every pill, every lift-on-focus poster exists because the tvOS app it's modeling does the same thing. The palette is deliberately monochrome: a true near-black canvas, off-white text and controls, zero color accent anywhere. Depth comes from blur and glow, not from color or hard shadow. Confirmed rejection: no static box-shadow on any element at rest (posters, cards, rows) - shadow/glow is exclusively a hover/focus response.
keyCharacteristics: True near-black canvas (#050505), not pure black
Monochrome black/white palette, zero color accent
SF Pro Display system stack (brand-correct: Apple TV's own face)
Glass/blur chrome (topbar, all modals, toast) via backdrop-filter: blur() saturate()
Zero-shadow-at-rest poster tiles that lift with scale + translateY + soft glow only on hover/focus
Pill radius (999px) for every interactive control vs. 14px for media cards - a deliberate, documented split
Hand-authored inline SVG icon set; no emoji, no icon fonts
Slow ambient background-drift on hero/detail backdrop art, compositor-only, respects prefers-reduced-motion
View Transitions API drives tab switches and grid-to-detail takeovers, with a no-op fallback

rules.name: The No Hue Rule
rules.body: The palette carries zero chromatic accent. Emphasis is achieved only through value contrast (white-on-black, translucency, blur) and motion, never through introducing a color.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section and detail titles never carry a kicker, label, or all-caps lead-in above them. tvOS itself doesn't use one; the row title stands alone.

rules.name: The Zero-Shadow-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Poster tiles in a shelf never carry a shadow or border at rest. Depth is earned only by hover/focus interaction - never applied as an ambient default.

rules.name: The Pill/Card Split Rule
rules.body: Two radii carry the whole system: 999px (full pill) for every interactive control, and 14px for media surfaces. Nothing in the system uses a sharp (0px) corner.

dos: Do keep every interactive control on the 999px pill radius and every media surface on 14px - never mix the two.
Do treat backdrop-filter glass as the only surface-layering device (topbar, modals, toast); don't introduce opaque panel chrome instead.
Do keep poster/card shadows and lift interaction-only (hover/focus); nothing static.
Do author new icons as inline SVG at the existing single stroke-width/scale-from-font-size convention; never drop in an icon font or emoji glyph.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for every new animation the way hero-drift and card-in already do.
donts: Don't introduce a color accent. The system's only emphasis device is value contrast (white/black inversion) plus translucency and motion.
Don't add a kicker, eyebrow, or all-caps label above section or detail titles - the row title stands alone, unlabeled.
Don't center the detail view in a card or banner. The title lockup stays bottom-left, overlapping the backdrop image.
Don't apply a static box-shadow to a poster or grid card at rest; the --glow token is a hover/focus response only, not a default treatment.
